title: Tracking, proof of delivery, receipts and records
keywords: track tracking number sms link proof delivered receipt invoice waybill print history report saved 60 days
body: Every job has a tracking number; customers can track at uparcel.sg/track or via the SMS tracking link.
Customer gets phone and email notification on delivery, with recipient name, signature and time.
Receipt is emailed after delivery. Waybill: Manage Deliveries → Print Waybill.
Orders are saved for 60 days (e.g. posted 1 Apr, viewable until 31 May).
